rank1.negative_coefficients: covered because F3(-Q)=F3(Q) and T -> -T permutes the full torsion subgroup

rank1_global_theorem_target.name: ODD_FRESH_FACTOR_PER_FIXED_TORSION_TRANSLATE
rank1_global_theorem_target.definition: For fixed (q,T), a prime ell is fresh at n when ell divides N_{q,T}(n) and ell divides no N_{q,T}(m) for 1<=m<n. Cross-translate nonoccurrence is NOT required.
rank1_global_theorem_target.sufficient_statement: For each fixed (q,T), there is an explicit effective N0(q,T) such that every n>=N0(q,T) has some fresh prime ell with v_ell(N_{q,T}(n)) odd.
rank1_global_theorem_target.why_sufficient: Odd valuation alone makes the same reduced numerator nonsquare. Freshness is only a mechanism to force a new usable odd valuation; comparing against other torsion translates is unnecessary for same-point exclusion.
rank1_global_theorem_target.finite_exception_contract: Every n<N0(q,T) must be discharged for that exact (q,T), using existing finite-window credit only where the threshold lies inside the audited n<=200 window.
rank1_global_theorem_target.firewall: A theorem for T=O does not cover T!=O without an explicit translate theorem or symmetry adapter.

rank2_global_theorem_target.name: DIRECT_RANK2_NONSQUARE_OR_ODD_VALUATION_OUTSIDE_FINITE_BOX
rank2_global_theorem_target.reason: There is no canonical one-dimensional predecessor order on Z^2 compatible with the source contract, and Paper C supplies no two-variable divisibility sequence. Inventing a primitive ordering would add an unnecessary semantic obligation.
sufficient_statement_options: There is an explicit effective B0 such that for every (a,b) with max(|a|,|b|)>=B0 and every torsion T, N_T(a,b) has a prime of odd valuation.
Equivalently strong: F3(aG1+bG2+T) is a nonsquare for every lattice point outside an explicit finite box, with all exceptional points exactly discharged.
rank2_global_theorem_target.finite_exception_contract: Existing Paper-C credit covers only max(|a|,|b|)<=12 with (a,b)!=(0,0). Any proved B0>13 creates a new finite annulus that must be exactly checked.
rank2_global_theorem_target.firewall: No one-variable EDS/primitive-divisor theorem receives rank-two credit merely by restricting to individual rays; infinitely many primitive lattice directions would remain.

mw_basis_dependency.if_source_free_index_is_1: Paper-C source coordinates give the full free Mordell-Weil lattice; this contract becomes the exact all-rational-point population modulo torsion.
mw_basis_dependency.if_source_free_index_exceeds_1: The existing finite windows cover only a proper finite-index sublattice. Stage34 must switch to the saturated basis and redo finite exception coverage or explicitly narrow the receiver; no silent promotion is allowed.
